biotools.summary: fEMR-OnChain-Core is an open-source electronic health record system designed for humanitarian emergencies and resource-limited settings. It has been deployed in numerous countries and continents to serve over 37,500 patient encounters, demonstrating ease of use by diverse clinicians.
